# Moisture retention and plasticity regressions for two groups of Nigerian soils.

## Source

Lal, R. (1979). Physical properties and moisture retention characteristics of some Nigerian soils. Geoderma, 21, 209-223.

[DOI: 10.1016/0016-7061(78)90028-9](https://doi.org/10.1016/0016-7061(78)90028-9)

## Scope

**Territory:** Nigeria

**Dataset:** 119 genetic-horizon samples from 23 profiles in two parent-material groups.
